$comment: AI crawler access in robots.txt (SEO & GEO Dashboard Spec, Pratik 29 Oct 2026, section 6; src/pages/robots.txt.ts). true = Allow, false = Disallow the whole site for that crawler. Default all true = the same access every crawler already had under 'User-agent: *' (spec recommendation; open question to the client). Staging (INDEXABLE = false) disallows everything whatever is set here. The CMS settings screen edits this file later (Phase 2).
